es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno responde a la oposición de Apple a su citación, insistiendo en obtener información sobre negociaciones de licencias actuales, cláusulas anti‑IA y conversaciones de Apple Music con sellos mayores, argumentando que es esencial para sus defensas de uso justo y abuso de derechos de autor.

items.title: Elvis Presley IP Owners Sue Anthropic Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Los titulares de los derechos de Elvis Presley han presentado una demanda contra Anthropic, alegando que la empresa utilizó 274 canciones del cantante para entrenar sus modelos de IA sin obtener autorización, lo que consideran una infracción de derechos de autor.

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: Suno enfrenta una serie creciente de demandas de derechos de autor en la industria musical y ha recibido múltiples citaciones que incluyen solicitudes de documentos y deposiciones, dirigidas a la MLC, inversores, DistroKid y Apple Music, lo que sugiere posibles revelaciones significativas en el futuro.

items.title: Anthropic sued over Elvis catalog — and the 274-song copyright battle shows the AI industry's 'fair use' excuses are getting old
items.summary: Anthropic enfrenta una demanda por el catálogo de Elvis, donde la disputa de 274 canciones cuestiona las defensas de 'uso justo' que la industria de IA ha utilizado.

items.title: Reservoir Sues Suno and Anthropic Over AI Music Copyright, Seeking Nearly $338 Million
items.summary: Reservoir presenta una demanda contra Suno y Anthropic por infracción de derechos de autor en música generada por IA, solicitando aproximadamente 338 millones de dólares en compensación.

items.title: AI Music Copyright Lawsuit — BTS & Psy Songs Used Without Permission in $12B Legal Battle
items.summary: Una demanda de derechos de autor alega que canciones de BTS y Psy fueron usadas sin permiso en una disputa legal valorada en 12 mil millones de dólares.

items.title: Claude’s lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.summary: Los editores de música Universal, Concord y ABKCO argumentan en el proceso contra Anthropic que las letras generadas por Claude están diluyendo las letras reales, reavivando el debate sobre el uso justo de entrenamientos de IA bajo la ley de derechos de autor de EE. UU.

items.title: Suno Accused of Training AI on BTS and Psy Hits Without Permission in Copyright Case Over 60,202 Recordings
items.summary: Suno es acusado de entrenar su IA con éxitos de BTS y Psy sin autorización, en una demanda de derechos de autor que involucra 60 202 grabaciones.

items.title: Suno fights to make Apple testify on whether Apple Music could survive without UMG and Sony, claiming the majors use their catalogs ‘as a cudgel’ to win anti-AI concessions
items.summary: Suno solicita que un testigo de Apple declare sobre las negociaciones de licencias actuales de Apple Music y supuesta fraude de streaming, alegando que los sellos mayores usan sus catálogos como presión para obtener concesiones anti‑IA.

items.title: UMG talks AI music: ‘The volume is growing faster than the safeguards’
items.summary: En la llamada de resultados trimestrales, Lucian Grainge de Universal Music Group advirtió que la cantidad de pistas totalmente generadas por IA supera los 90 000 por día, indicando que el crecimiento supera a las medidas de protección existentes.

items.title: Propietarios de la música de Elvis Presley demandan a Anthropic por infracción de derechos de autor
items.summary: Los propietarios de la música de Elvis Presley presentan una demanda contra Anthropic, alegando infracción de derechos de autor por el uso no autorizado de sus obras.

items.title: Suno’s new MCP tool lets users make songs inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini – as its developer API gets a sign-in portal but remains in beta
items.summary: Suno lanzó la herramienta MCP, que permite crear canciones dentro de asistentes de IA como ChatGPT, Claude y Gemini; la API para desarrolladores está en beta y ahora incluye un portal de inicio de sesión.

tip.title: Registra tu catálogo también en la sociedad de gestión
tip.body: El registro de autoría y la recaudación son trámites distintos. Si tu obra no está dada de alta en la sociedad correspondiente, las regalías de ejecución pública simplemente no te llegan.

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno pushes back against Apple’s attempt to quash its subpoena, demanding details on current licensing talks, anti‑AI deal terms and Apple Music’s major‑label negotiations, asserting the data is crucial to its fair‑use and copyright‑misuse defenses.

items.title: Elvis Presley IP Owners Sue Anthropic Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Elvis Presley’s rightsholders have sued Anthropic, claiming the AI firm used 274 of the singer’s songs to train its models without permission, which they allege constitutes copyright infringement.

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: Suno is confronting an expanding wave of music‑industry copyright complaints and has been served with subpoenas demanding documents and depositions from the MLC, investors, DistroKid and Apple Music, hinting at potentially major disclosures ahead.

items.title: Anthropic sued over Elvis catalog — and the 274-song copyright battle shows the AI industry's 'fair use' excuses are getting old
items.summary: Anthropic is sued over the Elvis catalog, with a 274‑song copyright battle challenging the AI industry’s reliance on “fair use” defenses.

items.title: Reservoir Sues Suno and Anthropic Over AI Music Copyright, Seeking Nearly $338 Million
items.summary: Reservoir sues Suno and Anthropic for AI‑generated music copyright infringement, seeking nearly $338 million in damages.

items.title: AI Music Copyright Lawsuit — BTS & Psy Songs Used Without Permission in $12B Legal Battle
items.summary: A copyright lawsuit claims BTS and Psy songs were used without permission in a $12 billion legal battle.

items.title: Claude’s lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.summary: Music publishers Universal, Concord and ABKCO contend in the Anthropic case that Claude’s AI‑generated lyrics are diluting real lyrics, reigniting the U.S. copyright fair‑use debate over AI training.

items.title: Suno Accused of Training AI on BTS and Psy Hits Without Permission in Copyright Case Over 60,202 Recordings
items.summary: Suno is accused of training its AI on BTS and Psy hits without permission in a copyright case covering 60,202 recordings.

items.title: Suno fights to make Apple testify on whether Apple Music could survive without UMG and Sony, claiming the majors use their catalogs ‘as a cudgel’ to win anti-AI concessions
items.summary: Suno seeks an Apple witness to testify on current Apple Music licensing negotiations and alleged streaming fraud, claiming major labels wield their catalogs as leverage to secure anti‑AI concessions.

items.title: UMG talks AI music: ‘The volume is growing faster than the safeguards’
items.summary: During UMG’s quarterly earnings call, Lucian Grainge warned that fully AI‑generated tracks exceed 90,000 daily, noting that the volume is increasing faster than existing safeguards.

items.title: Propietarios de la música de Elvis Presley demandan a Anthropic por infracción de derechos de autor
items.summary: Elvis Presley music owners file a lawsuit against Anthropic, claiming copyright infringement for unauthorized use of their works.

items.title: Suno’s new MCP tool lets users make songs inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini – as its developer API gets a sign-in portal but remains in beta
items.summary: Suno introduced the MCP tool, enabling song creation inside AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini; its developer API remains in beta and now features a sign‑in portal.

tip.title: Register with your collecting society too
tip.body: Copyright registration and royalty collection are separate steps. If your work isn't registered with the right society, public performance royalties simply never reach you.
